raw_block.rationale: The Federal/Oregon producer is precise for animals and firearms but treats vehicles and household goods as generic property, causing systematic omissions. Extending the same independent-pair skeleton with the expressly supplied vehicle and household provisions preserves its successful behavior and adds the missing claims.

skill.intent: Build all independently applicable Federal and Oregon exemption claims for current personal-use animals, firearms, motor vehicles, household goods, and other property, capping each claim by asset value.
